title: CollectionCreateRequest
description: Create a content-addressed collection bound to a registered embedding model and a chunk strategy. Build-time config is collection identity, so this mints a new collection rather than editing one. The collection is created empty; populate it via POST /v1/ingest with the returned collection id.

embedding.description: Id of a registered model whose task is `embedding` (see GET /v1/admin/models/registry). Its base_urls are SSRF-checked at registration; the model must declare a positive `dim`.

method.description: Chunker method (e.g. fixed_token, fixed, sentence, words, semantic).

id.description: Optional explicit collection id. Omitted → derived from the content-addressed (model, dim, chunk) signature.
